decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board and disrupt your opponent's strategy using a combination of counterspells and removal spells. By efficiently removing threats and countering key spells, while also deploying powerful creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Spyglass Siren, you can quickly overwhelm your opponent and secure victory. The deck focuses on tempo and maintaining board presence with efficient and versatile creatures, while also utilizing some card draw and mana fixing to ensure consistency in your plays.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and using combat tricks to deal quick and efficient damage to the opponent. The deck includes a mix of low-cost aggressive creatures like Bloodghast and Marauding Mako, supported by cards like Practiced Offense and Requiting Hex to give them an edge in combat. Additionally, the deck includes disruption in the form of Erode and Cool but Rude to disrupt an opponent's game plan. The goal of this deck is to apply constant pressure and overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of aggression and disruption. With a strong mana base and a mix of low-cost creatures and spells, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and often. Cards like Marauding Mako and Iron-Shield Elf provide efficient threats, while spells like Erode and Requiting Hex disrupt the opponent's game plan. This deck seeks to maintain a fast pace and keep the opponent on the back foot, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with high-powered creatures and then bring them back to the battlefield with reanimation spells. It includes ways to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to outvalue the opponent by leveraging the synergy between the graveyard recursion and powerful creatures. By combining control elements and a fast win condition, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can establish a strong board presence.

The deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells and card draw to control the board and outvalue the opponent. By using cards like Abandon Attachments and Avengers Disassembled to remove threats while accumulating cards with Accumulate Wisdom and Tablet of Discovery, the deck aims to maintain control of the game until it can close out with powerful finishers like Jeskai Revelation and Thor, God of Thunder. Additionally, cards like It'll Quench Ya! and Combustion Technique provide additional removal and reach to help secure victories. The deck's strategy is to control the game and grind out wins through card advantage and powerful spells.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures like Llanowar Elves and Sazh's Chocobo, while also utilizing cards like Earthbender Ascension and Esper Origins to buff and protect them. It aims to swarm the opponent with aggressive plays and overwhelm them with a flood of powerful creatures. The inclusion of Mightform Harmonizer and Demolition Field adds to the deck's versatility and allows for explosive turns. The deck's strategy revolves around early aggression and maintaining pressure throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Fabled Passage, while using aggressive creatures like Ba Sing Se and Sazh's Chocobo to apply early pressure on the opponent. Cards like Earthbender Ascension and Mightform Harmonizer help buff up creatures for big swings, while Escape Tunnel provides protection. The deck also includes cards like Demolition Field and Lumbering Worldwagon for additional control and finishers. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient mono green aggro strategy.

The main focus of this Red Deck Wins deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing powerful dragons like Sarkhan, Dragon Ascendant, Smaug the Magnificent, and Magmatic Hellkite, as well as efficient burn spells like Shock and Burst Lightning, the deck aims to deal damage to the opponent's life total as quickly as possible. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Magda, the Hoardmaster and Soulstone Sanctuary provide some card advantage and resiliency to the deck.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful burn spells. Utilizing a mix of dragons and other powerful creatures, along with efficient removal spells like Burst Lightning, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and close out the game quickly. With a focus on dealing damage directly to the opponent and controlling the board with powerful creatures, the deck seeks to end the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and tempo plays. The deck aims to quickly establish a board presence with cards like Drake Hatcher and Elusive Otter, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Slickshot Show-Off and Gandalf, Goblins' Bane. The deck also includes card draw and filtering spells like Sleight of Hand and Opt to ensure consistent draws and maintain pressure on the opponent. Overall, the deck's strategy is to apply constant pressure and outpace the opponent to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells in order to quickly reduce their life total to zero. This is accomplished by playing efficient creatures like Iron-Shield Elf and Marauding Mako alongside disruptive spells like Erode and Requiting Hex. The deck also includes a strong mana base to ensure consistent casting of its spells, and cards like Bloodghast provide additional value when they are moved from the graveyard to the battlefield. Overall, the goal is to maintain aggressive pressure and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of efficient removal spells like Burst Lightning and Sunderflock, along with disruptive elements such as Impractical Joke and Traumatic Critique. By utilizing card draw and selection spells like Sleight of Hand and Opt, the deck aims to consistently hit its key threats like Hearth Elemental and Eddymurk Crab. The land base provides a mix of mana fixing and card advantage, allowing the player to out-value and out-maneuver their opponent in a slow and methodical game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, then bringing them back into play for a big swing. It uses a combination of card draw, control spells, and reanimation effects to set up this combo. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up resources for a devastating finish with high-value creatures. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by leveraging the graveyard as a resource and overwhelming them with powerful threats that can quickly turn the tide of the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy through counterspells and removal spells. It utilizes creatures like Eddymurk Crab and Hearth Elemental to maintain board presence while controlling the game with cards such as Spell Pierce and Spell Snare. The deck also includes burn spells like Burst Lightning and Prismari Charm for additional removal options. With a mix of card draw, counterspells, and removal, the deck aims to maintain control of the game and outlast the opponent until it can secure a win condition.

This Jeskai Control deck focuses on utilizing a variety of spells and abilities to control the game state while drawing cards and managing resources efficiently. With a mix of removal, card draw, and counterspells, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents in longer games. The deck includes a combination of powerful instant and sorcery spells, along with lands that provide flexibility and consistency in casting spells of different colors. It also includes a few unique cards to provide additional utility or advantage in specific situations.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a mix of low-cost creatures and powerful spells. The deck aims to control the board early on while gradually building up its own forces, utilizing cards like Lunar Convocation and Haliya, Guided by Light to maintain momentum. The inclusion of cards like Emptiness and Shattered Sanctum help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Moseo, Vein's New Dean and Aunt May provide additional value and flexibility. Overall, the key strategy is to apply consistent pressure and outpace the opponent with efficient plays.
